links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT answers across repeated runs of the same question
links.effect: ChatGPT had a reproducibility score of 93%, consistently reproducing answers conveying similar meanings across multiple runs.
links.quote: Furthermore, ChatGPT had a reproducibility score of 93%, meaning that it could consistently reproduce answers that conveyed similar meanings across multiple runs.

links.outcome: Clinical appropriateness of ChatGPT hypertension answers against guideline-based reference standards
links.effect: ChatGPT responses were appropriate in 92.5% of cases and inappropriate (containing errors) in 7.5%.
links.quote: When assessed against acceptable standard responses, ChatGPT responses were found to be appropriate in 92.5% of cases and inappropriate in 7.5%.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and reproducibility of ChatGPT responses to hypertension questions against clinical standards, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
